question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.3.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Many'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given blank needs a **determiner** to clarify the **noun dance forms.**
 
• Since, **dance forms **is a countable noun, the correct determiner to use here is **many.**
 
• Hence, option 3 is the correct answer. 

*Correct passage - **Dance as an artistic form of (1) expression is extremely old. Evidence of dance as a (2) creative form is available in ancient literary texts, painting and sculpture. (3) Many of the dance forms trace their roots to the (4) techniques of movement codified in the Natya Shastra (5) compiled by Bharat Muni.*
